spartoi_skeleton: A Spartoi skeleton warrior from Greek myth, risen from sown dragon teeth: a lean bone-white skeleton with yellowed old bones, wearing a battered bronze Corinthian helmet with a faded crimson crest, a cracked round bronze hoplite shield and a short leaf-shaped bronze sword, scraps of a torn faded red cloak, faint green-teal glow in the eye sockets.
barrow_skeleton: An undead skeleton hoplite rising from an ancient island barrow: weathered ivory bones, a verdigris-green bronze helmet without crest, a rusted spear with a bronze tip, a small round wicker shield, a tattered dark linen kilt, leather straps, dust and soil on the bones.
wild_centaur: A wild island centaur from Greek myth: the upper body of a muscular bearded man with wild dark hair and a laurel of ivy, joined at the waist to the body of a chestnut-brown horse with a dark mane and tail, a leopard skin over one shoulder, holding a short recurve bow with a quiver of arrows on his back.
centaur_raider: A fierce centaur raider: a lean man's torso with a bronze-studded leather baldric and a wolf-pelt cape joined at the waist to a dappled grey horse body with feathered hooves, long braided hair, holding a long ash spear with a bronze head and a small round hide shield.
cyclops_general: A cyclops general, warlord of the one-eyed giants: a single huge eye in the middle of his forehead, a massive bronze breastplate with a hammered gorgon face, a giant crested bronze helmet with an opening for the one eye, a heavy dark red cloak, wielding a huge bronze-headed war maul, a grey beard.
labyrinth_minotaur: The Minotaur of the labyrinth from Greek myth: a towering muscular man with the head of a black bull, long curved ivory horns, a brass ring in his nose, a red-and-white Minoan patterned kilt with a gold belt, bronze wrist guards, wielding a huge double-headed labrys axe.
bronze_minotaur: A minotaur temple guardian: a massive bull-headed giant with a tawny brown bull head and wide horns capped with bronze, a bronze chest harness, a blue-and-white Minoan wave-pattern kilt, gold armbands, carrying a huge bronze double axe, hooves for feet.
cyclops_brute: A terrifying cyclops giant from Greek myth: a hulking hunched monster three times a man's height, a single enormous bloodshot glaring eye in the middle of a heavy brow, a wide snarling mouth full of jagged teeth with two lower tusks, ash-grey sun-scarred hide with old battle scars, a bald scarred head with a few black hair tufts, a tattered goatskin loincloth with a belt of bones, huge clawed hands, carrying a massive club studded with embedded rocks and bones.
cyclops_savage: A savage, frightening cyclops: a towering muscular giant with sickly olive-grey skin, one huge yellow eye with a slit-like red-rimmed glare, a single short horn above the eye, a lipless snarl with long fangs, wild matted black hair down his back, a necklace of sheep skulls, a rough hide loincloth, scarred arms and enormous hands, dragging a giant club made from a broken ship's mast wrapped in rope.
beast_chameleon: A strange, frightening cyclops beast inspired by a giant chameleon: a hulking hunched giant with bumpy turquoise-and-ochre chameleon scales, a casqued crested head, a long curled prehensile tail, two-toed grasping clawed hands and feet, a wide lipless mouth, carrying a massive club studded with rocks. He has one single huge eye in the middle of his face, turned 90 degrees: a tall vertical eye standing upright, with eyelids that open sideways and a vertical slit pupil, bloodshot and unsettling.
beast_mandrill: A strange, frightening cyclops beast inspired by a giant mandrill baboon: a hulking hunched ape-like giant with thick olive-grey fur, a long muzzle with vivid red and blue ridged cheeks, huge yellow fangs, a mane of shaggy fur, long powerful arms with knuckles near the ground, a bone belt, carrying a massive club studded with rocks. He has one single huge eye in the middle of his face, turned 90 degrees: a tall vertical eye standing upright, with eyelids that open sideways and a vertical slit pupil, bloodshot and unsettling.
beast_pangolin: A strange, frightening cyclops beast inspired by a giant pangolin: a hulking hunched giant covered in overlapping bronze-brown keratin scales like armour plates, a long narrow scaled snout, a thick armoured tail, huge curved digging claws, a pale bare belly, carrying a massive club studded with rocks. He has one single huge eye in the middle of his face, turned 90 degrees: a tall vertical eye standing upright, with eyelids that open sideways and a vertical slit pupil, bloodshot and unsettling.
beast_shoebill: A strange, frightening cyclops beast inspired by a giant shoebill stork: a hulking hunched giant with slate-grey feathers, a massive hooked clog-shaped beak, scaly bird legs with long talons, ragged feather crest, muscular feathered arms ending in clawed hands, carrying a massive club studded with rocks. He has one single huge eye in the middle of his face, turned 90 degrees: a tall vertical eye standing upright, with eyelids that open sideways and a vertical slit pupil, bloodshot and unsettling.
